title: API - POST /api/part/category/ creates root and nested categories
preconditions: InvenTree instance is running with test database initialized
Valid authentication token available with write permissions

steps.action: Send POST request to /api/part/category/ with rootPayload and header 'Authorization: Token <token>'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 201 Created returned with id, name='Mechanical Hardware', parent=null, and pathstring='Mechanical Hardware'

steps.action: Send POST request to /api/part/category/ with childPayload referencing rootId and header 'Authorization: Token <token>'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 201 Created returned with integer id, parent=<rootId>, and pathstring='Mechanical Hardware/Bolts & Screws'

postConditions: Both categories exist in database and can be retrieved via GET /api/part/category/{id}/

title: API - POST /api/part/category/ validation constraints and duplicate name rejection
preconditions: Root category 'Fasteners' already exists in the database
Valid authentication token available

testDataRequirements.longNamePayload: {"name": "This category name exceeds the one hundred character maximum limit imposed by the InvenTree database schema validation rule set"}

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned with validation error on name field
HTTP 400 Bad Request returned indicating maximum 100 character constraint violation

steps.action: Send POST to /api/part/category/ with duplicateNamePayload under root scope (parent: null)
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned indicating category name must be unique within same parent scope

postConditions: No invalid category records are inserted into the database

title: API - GET /api/part/category/ hierarchy filtering and ordering
preconditions: Database populated with 2 root categories ('Electronics', 'Mechanics') and 2 children under 'Electronics' ('Passives', 'Actives')

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK returned containing only the 2 root categories ('Electronics', 'Mechanics')
HTTP 200 OK returned containing only direct child categories ('Passives', 'Actives')
HTTP 200 OK returned with categories ordered alphabetically by name

postConditions: Read queries execute without state side-effects

title: API - GET /api/part/category/{id}/ detail and pathstring verification
preconditions: Category hierarchy 'Assemblies/Power Supplies' exists with 3 assigned parts

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK returned with id, name='Power Supplies', pathstring='Assemblies/Power Supplies', and part_count=3

postConditions: Detail payload adheres strictly to schema

title: API - GET /api/part/category/{id}/ returns 404 for non-existent category
preconditions: InvenTree instance is running

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found returned with error details

postConditions: No database changes

title: API - PUT /api/part/category/{id}/ updates name and propagates pathstring
preconditions: Parent category 'Robotics' exists with child category 'Sensors'
Sensors has pathstring 'Robotics/Sensors'

steps.action: Send PUT /api/part/category/<roboticsId>/ with updatePayload and auth header
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK returned with updated name 'Advanced Robotics'

steps.action: Send GET /api/part/category/<sensorsId>/ to inspect child category pathstring
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK returned with updated pathstring 'Advanced Robotics/Sensors'

postConditions: All descendant categories reflect updated pathstring

title: DB - PUT /api/part/category/{id}/ rejects circular hierarchy cycle
preconditions: Category A is parent of Category B, Category B is parent of Category C

steps.action: Send PUT /api/part/category/<categoryAId>/ with circularPayload attempting to set parent to Category C
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned preventing circular hierarchy cycle (Category A -> B -> C -> A)

postConditions: Hierarchy remains acyclic; Category A parent remains null

title: API - DELETE /api/part/category/{id}/ successfully deletes empty category
preconditions: An empty category 'Temporary Category' exists with zero parts and zero child categories

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 204 No Content returned
HTTP 404 Not Found confirms category was removed

postConditions: Target category no longer exists in database

title: DB - DELETE /api/part/category/{id}/ blocked when category contains parts
preconditions: Category 'Motors' contains 2 assigned parts

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned with error message stating category cannot be deleted while it contains parts
HTTP 200 OK confirms category still exists and parts remain intact

postConditions: Category and all assigned parts remain completely preserved

title: API - POST /api/part/ creates new Part with mandatory and optional attributes
preconditions: Category 'Resistors' exists with known integer ID
Valid authentication token available

testDataRequirements.partPayload: {"name": "10k Ohm Resistor 0805", "category": <resistorsId>, "IPN": "RES-0805-10K", "description": "Surface mount chip resistor 1%", "purchaseable": true, "saleable": true}

steps.action: Send POST /api/part/ with partPayload and auth header
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 201 Created returned with integer id, name, category, IPN='RES-0805-10K', and active=true default

postConditions: New part is queryable via GET /api/part/{id}/ and appears in part catalogue

title: API - POST /api/part/ input validation and duplicate IPN rejection
preconditions: Existing part exists with IPN 'MCU-STM32F401'
Valid authentication token available

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned with error on required field 'name'
HTTP 400 Bad Request returned with invalid foreign key error on 'category'
HTTP 400 Bad Request returned stating IPN must be globally unique

postConditions: No duplicate or malformed part records inserted

title: API - GET /api/part/ paginated list envelope and response time SLA
preconditions: Database populated with at least 50 distinct parts

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK returned within 2,000ms with envelope containing count >= 50, next URL, previous=null, and results array with length 15

steps.action: Inspect first element of results array
steps.expectedResult: Item contains id, name, description, category object/ID, IPN, and active status

postConditions: Response adheres to pagination contract

title: API - GET /api/part/ negative pagination boundary handling
preconditions: InvenTree instance is running

steps.expectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request returned rejecting negative limit
HTTP 400 Bad Request returned rejecting negative offset

postConditions: No unexpected internal server errors (500)
